title: Run the pkg/bindings unit tests in CI
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->
Fixes: #29801

#### Description

`localunit` currently skips `pkg/bindings` entirely because the
`--skip-package` option matches substrings. The intention is to skip only
`pkg/bindings/test`, which needs a running Podman service.

Because of this, 30 unit tests in `pkg/bindings`,
`pkg/bindings/internal/util`, and `pkg/bindings/images` are not being run
in CI.

Changing the skip path also exposes `TestConvertAdditionalBuildContexts`,
which assumes that `C:\test` is converted to `/mnt/c/test`. That conversion
is only expected on Windows or in a WSL/Hyper-V environment, so the
Windows-specific case is moved to its own test file.

The changes are:

- Move the `C:\test` case from `build_test.go` to a new
  `build_windows_test.go`, following the existing platform-specific test
  layout in `pkg/specgen`.
- Change the Makefile skip entry from `pkg/bindings` to
  `pkg/bindings/test`.

#### Testing

- Ran `ginkgo -r --skip-package pkg/bindings/test ./pkg/bindings` using the
  vendored Ginkgo. All three suites passed.
- Ran `GOOS=windows go vet` for the new test file.
- Ran `golangci-lint 2.13.2` on the changed package; no issues were reported.
